limitations: One-dimensional full-support location families and deterministic interval quantizers only; the statement is about local Fisher information, not global sufficiency or finite-sample risk. The full theorem text of Pötzelberger--Felsenstein (1993) was not completely inspected and remains the principal residual originality risk.
provenance: A fixed-quantizer Fisher-information equality criterion combined with the translation structure of location scores and an exact finite-set sumset argument.
record_title: Exact Fisher-information preservation at multiple locations under a fixed interval quantizer
